source: Yu et al. 2025, NASA NTRS 20250004626, Figure 1(b), Sections 2.2.1–2.2.2 and Table 5
scope: Published component arrangement; normalized visual dimensions are authoring assumptions, not measured CAD. No dimensions are inferred from cell resistance. Visual and computational geometry are separate.

wall.material: 10.5 wt% YSZ, as reported in fabrication
wall.role: Primary regolith containment and solid electrolyte

anode.material: Pt wire mesh and Pt ink

gas.material: Ar carrier gas with evolved O2

published_performance.scope: Separate cells. Resistance measurements are not electrolysis voltage, universal pass thresholds or a calibrated bulk-conductivity fit.

limitations: Visual dimensions are normalized, not verified as-built dimensions.
10.5 wt% YSZ is not automatically equivalent to generic 8 mol% material coefficients.
Resistance changes do not establish a degradation mechanism or oxygen-collection efficiency.
